business_problem: Empolis wanted to enhance its knowledge-management SaaS products so users no longer had to manually search through manuals and operating procedures for answers, troubleshooting guidance, and product information.
solution_summary: Empolis extended its knowledge-management SaaS portfolio with a generative AI assistant called Empolis Buddy by building on Amazon Bedrock. The assistant is integrated into existing Empolis products and can query millions of documents, including standard operating procedures and manufacturing manuals, to surface precise answers for end users. Empolis developed the offering with AWS and validated it in collaboration with customer KUKA, using Bedrock to access large language models without managing the underlying model infrastructure itself. This architecture lets the assistant sit on top of large enterprise document corpora and deliver advanced search, troubleshooting, and operational guidance in natural language. The result is a reusable generative AI knowledge layer that helps industrial users learn faster, resolve issues sooner, and prevent operational problems.

solution_components.name: Amazon Bedrock
solution_components.role: Hosts the large language models used by Empolis Buddy to answer questions across large document collections.

data_flow: Millions of manuals, standard operating procedures, and product-information documents are queried through Empolis Buddy, which uses Amazon Bedrock to turn document content into natural-language answers for end users.
business_outcome: Empolis created a generative AI assistant that lets users search and query millions of documents conversationally, helping customers such as KUKA troubleshoot machinery faster, learn more about their equipment, and prevent operational issues.
architecture_clues: Built as an extension of existing knowledge-management SaaS products.
Validated in a proof of concept with customer KUKA.
Targets large industrial document corpora rather than a narrow single-manual workflow.
